chunks: So have patience. The promise of God is surely true; and let not those who do not believe make you relax (your endeavours).

key_terms.يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ: Make you relax / make you feel light

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for those who do not believe to make you relax your endeavours?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ar-Rum, this verse follows the narrative of the Byzantine victory over the Persians, serving as a divine confirmation of the Prophet's earlier prediction and a test of faith for the believers. Shia scholarship emphasizes that 'steadfastness' (sabr) here is not passive endurance but an active, conscious adherence to truth amidst the skepticism of those who lack deep spiritual certainty (yaqin). It underscores the principle that divine promises are absolute, requiring believers to remain firm against the trivializing doubts of the unconvincing.
